design_condition: The long volume extends toward the plot boundaries, steps back on the north side, protects its eastern entrance, and forms a courtyard relationship with neighbouring buildings while leaving limited western open space.

positive.statement: The project creates a structured floor plan with a functional room arrangement.
The straight corridors are advantageous in terms of safety and have optimal lighting.
The easily accessible courtyard offers a large open space with maximum flexibility of use.
The wooden ceiling elements and solid interior walls form a functional and economical support system.
The south orientation of the patient rooms offers attractive exposure and sunlight.
The technical access, especially to the patient rooms from the corridor, is optimally solved.
The ecological construction approach responds to the limited period of use and gives the property a warm character.

negative.statement: The extensive footprint makes the new building appear very autonomous in relation to the surrounding development structure.
The pavilion expression does not correspond to the size of the object.
The entrance position is not entirely logical in view of the northern open space.
The western outside space is limited and not spatially clearly defined.
The entrance area is somewhat tight.
The smoking area and internal facade are not clearly defined.
The nearby facade severely limits the view from the patient rooms.
The importance of the flat roof as a fifth facade should be taken into account.
